name: expanding-search
title: Expanding search
description: A search that waits as a round icon in a busy toolbar and opens into a field where it stands: the circle stretches into a pill with a grey edge (the glyph stays put when it grows to the right), a / keycap waits while it is empty, a result count shows as you type, and the close button or Esc clears and folds it back.
author: UI Stacks <https://uistacks.dev>, MIT; free component, unchanged
